epics.title: Strain Management API
epics.jtbd: When operating the archive, I want to create and manage isolated strains, so that they can be subject to the access control rules.
requirements: R1: The system must provide CRUD endpoints to add, modify, and manage isolated strains.

slices.title: Implement Strain Management API patch
slices.jtbd: When implementing the Strain Management API for this epic, I want to patch the existing API logic, so that strain management capabilities are successfully integrated.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an authorized user
When they send a request to add or modify a strain
Then the system saves the strain with the provided access rules
Then unit and integration QA tests must execute and pass
